# pve_sdn_dns (Resource)

Manages an SDN reverse-DNS plugin object (`/cluster/sdn/dns`). The pin's only plugin type is `powerdns`. Changes stay pending until the `pve_sdn_apply` action runs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A reverse-DNS plugin registers guest IPs with PowerDNS. Run the
# `pve_sdn_apply` action afterwards to activate pending SDN changes.

resource "pve_sdn_dns" "pdns1" {
  dns           = "pdns1"
  url           = "https://pdns.example:8081/api/v1"
  key           = var.pdns_api_key
  reversemaskv6 = 64
  ttl           = 60
}

variable "pdns_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dns` (String) The SDN DNS object identifier (2 or more characters, starting with a letter). Changing this value forces recreation.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) API authentication key for the PowerDNS server.
- `url` (String) URL of the PowerDNS API server (for example `https://pdns.example:8081/api/v1`).

### Optional

- `fingerprint` (String) Certificate SHA 256 fingerprint of the PowerDNS server, as 32 colon-separated hex pairs.
- `reversemaskv6` (Number) Mask for IPv6 reverse lookups.
- `ttl` (Number) Record TTL for registered entries.

### Read-Only

- `type` (String) DNS plugin type; always `powerdns` for this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing SDN DNS plugin by its identifier:
terraform import pve_sdn_dns.pdns1 pdns1
```
